notes:
### Added

- **Long hints scroll to show the rest.** In a narrow editor, the status bar's hint used to end
  in "…". Rest the pointer for a moment and it glides along to the end, then back. Turn it off
  in **Settings › Markup › Scroll long hints**; it stays still when Windows is set to reduce
  motion.
- **Logs and crash reports, for when something goes wrong.** Vandal keeps a log of what it
  does, and a small report if it crashes, on your PC only: never your screenshots, file names,
  folders or text. After a crash, the next start says so, with the report a click away. Settings
  › About › Debugging opens the folder, clears it, or turns the log off.
- **Copy Style and Paste Style.** Ctrl+Alt+C (or **Copy Style** in the right-click menu) copies
  the selected mark's style, and Ctrl+Alt+V (**Paste Style**) gives it to the selected marks:
  colors, width, font and the rest. Another kind of mark takes what it has a place for, so an
  arrow's color becomes a rectangle's border and a text's background a shape's fill. Works in
  the editor and quick edit, and from one to the other.
- **Reset to defaults.** **Settings › About › Reset** puts every setting back as installed, or
  only the markup styles (colors, widths, sizes and fonts). Either way the markup tools forget
  the styles they remembered. Each asks first.
- **Reset a group of settings.** A group whose settings differ from the defaults has a **Reset**
  link by its heading, which puts back just that group. It asks first, with "Don't ask again"
  (**Settings › About › Reset › Ask before resetting a group** turns asking back on).

### Changed

- **New default styles for the markup tools** (new installs; saved settings keep theirs):
  colors are a dropdown, which takes less room than a row of swatches; lines go up to 30 px;
  callouts end in a dot, with their own 1-20 px width slider; the spotlight's darkness is a
  slider from 30 to 85 %; and step markers come in 72 px too.
- **Copying and pasting say "marks".** The right-click menu's Copy Object, Copy All Markup and
  Paste Markup are now **Copy Mark**, **Copy All Marks** and **Paste Marks**, and the status
  bar, hints and Settings call the things you draw marks throughout.
- **Settings › About links to Flowcat Software's new address,
  [flowcat.studio](https://flowcat.studio).**

### Fixed

- **Selecting different kinds of marks together shows the right style.** With a spotlight drawn
  before a rectangle or step marker, for example, the options bar showed the shape's controls
  with the spotlight's color.
- **The toolbar's Select icon sits level with the other tools.** Its arrow was drawn a little
  high.

### Security

- **The secure connection used to check for and download updates is up to date** (rustls
  0.23.46 and rustls-webpki 0.103.16), with fixes for certificate checks. Updates were always
  signature-checked as well.
